description: Land Title Settlement Department - Keerikkulama, Nuwaragampalatha-East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110191
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and encumbrances. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
